justification: GST-1821 (an outside review reads clean only from a last-line VERDICT token): preregistered no-loss probe, gpt-6-astra at high effort, codex-cli 0.167.0, six seeded-bug repos and three clean repos, two trials per case and arm, 54 scored runs. Codex's structured step moved from `codex review --base` (arm R) to `codex exec` with gstack's prompt, [P0]-[P3] tags and the last-line VERDICT request (arm X). X caught the seeded bug in 12 of 12 bug runs, R in 12 of 12 and the no-gstack arm in 12 of 12, so no catch was lost; all three arms are saturated, so a loss on subtler bugs is not ruled out. X ended with the VERDICT line in 18 of 18 runs and read clean on all 6 clean-case runs. The adversarial outside brief and the other outside prompt-file lines change only their closing request (the Recommendation line is kept and the same VERDICT request is appended); their finding, severity and Blocks instructions are byte-identical and were not probed separately. Free replay of 681 captured outside replies through the new parser: 0 moved toward clean.
